policies.description: Only users with the Administrator role have full Create, Read, Update, Delete access across all tables, including user groups. The caller must have an active Administrator role to invoke update_user_group.
references: Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables.

policies.description: Any request to update a record must validate all mandatory fields. For update_user_group the field group_id is mandatory and at least one other field (e.g., name, type, active) must be provided.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: Perform only one validated operation at a time when calling update_user_group. No batch or multi‑record updates are allowed for this tool.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.

policies.description: Never assume or fabricate IDs. The group_id supplied to update_user_group must be verified against existing data before performing the update.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.

policies.description: If a mandatory field is missing (e.g., group_id), the assistant must state which field is required instead of asking for further information.
references: User Clarification: Do not ask for further information. If the request is ambiguous, return the list and state the ambiguity. If a mandatory field is missing, state which field is required.

policies.description: If any of the above rules are violated (e.g., caller lacks Administrator role, mandatory fields missing, or ID not verified), the operation must be halted and the specific policy reason returned.
references: Policy Violation: If a user request violates any rule herein, you must halt the operation and provide the specific policy reason before pausing.
